035/**
036 * Session for {@link ParquetSerializer}.

130   @Override /* OutputStreamSerializerSession */
131   public boolean hasNativeBytes() {
132      // Parquet's column writer has no native byte-array primitive type — it stores byte[] as a raw
133      // BYTE_ARRAY column (at BinaryFormat.NOT_SET) or as a UTF-8 string column
134      // (at any other BinaryFormat, after the BinarySwap fires and emits the configured text wire form).
135      return false;
136   }
137
138   @Override
139   protected void doWrite(SerializerPipe pipe, Object o) throws IOException, SerializeException {
140      var out = pipe.getOutputStream();
141      var rows = collectBeans(o);
142      if (rows.isEmpty()) {
143         writeEmptyFile(out);
144         return;
145      }
146      var first = rows.get(0);
147      List<ParquetSchemaElement> schema;
148      // collectBeans() always returns rows whose first element is a BeanMap (bean / collection / array /
149      // single-value roots, all BeanMap-wrapped) or a Map (string-keyed and non-string-keyed map roots),
150      // so those are the only two cases.
151      if (first instanceof BeanMap<?> first2) {
152         var elementType = getClassMetaForObject(first2.getBean());
153         // For collection root: use element type for flat row schema (root.name, root.age).
154         // Each collection element becomes one Parquet row. Avoids list column format issues.
155         schema = new ParquetSchemaBuilder(ctx.getMarshallingContext(), ctx.writeDatesAsTimestamp, ctx.cycleHandling, ctx.maxRecursionDepth, ctx.nativeLogicalTypes).buildSchema(elementType, first);
156      } else {
157         var mapFirst = (Map<?,?>) first;
158         if (!(((Map<?,?>) o).keySet().iterator().next() instanceof String)) {
159            schema = new ParquetSchemaBuilder(ctx.getMarshallingContext(), ctx.writeDatesAsTimestamp, ctx.cycleHandling, ctx.maxRecursionDepth, ctx.nativeLogicalTypes)
160               .buildSchemaForKeyValuePairs(mapFirst.get("key"), mapFirst.get("value"));
161         } else {
162            schema = new ParquetSchemaBuilder(ctx.getMarshallingContext(), ctx.writeDatesAsTimestamp, ctx.cycleHandling, ctx.maxRecursionDepth, ctx.nativeLogicalTypes).buildSchemaFromMap(mapFirst);
163         }
164      }
165      var leafColumns = ParquetSchemaBuilder.getLeafColumns(schema);
166      writeMagic(out);
167      long dataStart = 4;
168      var rowGroups = new ArrayList<RowGroupMeta>();
169      long fileOffset = dataStart;
170      // Multi-row-group write (GAP-2 round-trip): split rows into batches of rowsPerRowGroup and emit one
171      // row group per batch.  Defaults keep the historical single-row-group output (the cap is huge), but a
172      // small rowGroupSize produces multiple groups for interop/round-trip coverage.
173      int rowsPerRowGroup = rowsPerRowGroup(leafColumns.size());
174      for (int start = 0; start < rows.size(); start += rowsPerRowGroup) {
175         var batch = rows.subList(start, Math.min(start + rowsPerRowGroup, rows.size()));
176         long groupStart = fileOffset;
177         var columnChunks = new ArrayList<ColumnChunkMeta>();
178         for (var col : leafColumns) {
179            var chunk = writeColumnChunk(out, batch, col, fileOffset);
180            columnChunks.add(chunk);
181            fileOffset += chunk.totalCompressedSize;
182         }
183         long totalByteSize = 0;
184         long totalCompressedSize = 0;
185         for (var c : columnChunks) {
186            totalByteSize += c.totalUncompressedSize;
187            totalCompressedSize += c.totalCompressedSize;
188         }
189         rowGroups.add(new RowGroupMeta(columnChunks, totalByteSize, batch.size(), groupStart, totalCompressedSize));
190      }
191      var footerBytes = writeFileMetaData(schema, rows.size(), rowGroups);
192      out.write(footerBytes);
193      writeLe4(out, footerBytes.length);
194      out.write(MAGIC);
195   }
196
197   /**
198    * Rows per row group, derived from the {@code rowGroupSize} byte budget via a coarse per-row estimate.
199    *
200    * <p>
201    * Real writers flush a group once its accumulated byte size crosses the budget; Juneau's column-oriented
202    * writer materializes whole columns at once, so we instead translate the byte budget into a row count
203    * using a nominal {@code BYTES_PER_ROW_ESTIMATE} per leaf column.  With the default 128&nbsp;MB budget this
204    * yields an effectively unbounded count (single group, unchanged output); a small {@code rowGroupSize}
205    * (e.g. set in a test) produces several groups.
206    */
207   private int rowsPerRowGroup(int leafColumnCount) {
208      long perRow = (long) Math.max(1, leafColumnCount) * BYTES_PER_ROW_ESTIMATE;
209      long n = Math.max(1, ctx.rowGroupSize / perRow);
210      return (int) Math.min(n, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
211   }
212
213   private static final int BYTES_PER_ROW_ESTIMATE = 32;
214
215   private void writeEmptyFile(OutputStream out) throws IOException {
216      writeMagic(out);
217      var schema = List.of(
218         new ParquetSchemaElement("root", null, null, null, 0, null, null, null, null, null));
219      var footerBytes = writeFileMetaData(schema, 0L, List.of());
220      out.write(footerBytes);
221      writeLe4(out, footerBytes.length);
222      out.write(MAGIC);
223   }
224
225   private static void writeMagic(OutputStream out) throws IOException {
226      out.write(MAGIC);
227   }
228
229   private static void writeLe4(OutputStream out, int v) throws IOException {
230      out.write(v & 0xFF);
231      out.write((v >> 8) & 0xFF);
232      out.write((v >> 16) & 0xFF);
233      out.write((v >> 24) & 0xFF);
234   }
235
236   private List<?> collectBeans(Object o) throws SerializeException {
237      if (o == null)
238         return List.of();
239      // Unwrap Optional at root so we serialize the inner value, not Optional as a bean
240      if (o instanceof Optional<?> o2) {
241         var inner = o2.orElse(null);
242         if (inner == null)
243            return List.of();
244         return collectBeans(inner);
245      }
246      var sType = getExpectedRootType(o);
247      if (sType.isMap()) {
248         var m = (Map<?,?>) o;
249         if (m.isEmpty())
250            return List.of();
251         var firstKey = m.keySet().iterator().next();
252         if (firstKey instanceof String || firstKey == null) {
253            // Apply POJO swaps to map values so types like A (with swap to JsonMap) use their swapped schema/encoding.
254            // Replace null keys with the null-key sentinel so they survive as a named column in the schema.
255            var swappedMap = m();
256            for (var e : m.entrySet()) {
257               var key = e.getKey() == null ? ctx.nullKeyString : trim(e.getKey());
258               var val = e.getValue();
259               if (val != null)
260                  val = applySwap(val, getClassMetaForObject(val));
261               swappedMap.put(key, val);
262            }
263            return List.of(swappedMap);
264         }
265         var result = new ArrayList<Map<String,Object>>(m.size());
266         for (var e : m.entrySet()) {
267            var row = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
268            row.put("key", e.getKey());
269            row.put("value", e.getValue());
270            result.add(row);
271         }
272         return result;
273      }
274      if (sType.isCollection() || sType.isArray()) {
275         Collection<?> list = sType.isArray() ? toList(sType.inner(), o) : (Collection<?>)o;
276         if (cn(list).startsWith("java.util.ImmutableCollections"))
277            list = new ArrayList<>(list);
278         var result = new ArrayList<BeanMap<?>>(list.size());
279         for (var e : list) {
280            if (e == null) {
281               result.add(toBeanMap(createWrapperBean(null)));
282               continue;
283            }
284            var swapped = applySwap(e, getClassMetaForObject(e));
285            var swappedType = getClassMetaForObject(swapped);
286            var origType = getClassMetaForObject(e);
287            Object toUse;
288            if (swappedType.isBean())
289               toUse = swapped;
290            else if (origType.isBean())
291               toUse = e;
292            else
293               toUse = swapped;
294            var useType = getClassMetaForObject(toUse);
295            if (useType.isBean())
296               result.add(toBeanMap(toUse));
297            else
298               result.add(toBeanMap(createWrapperBean(toUse)));
299         }
300         return result;
301      }
302      if (sType.isStreamable()) {
303         return collectBeans(toListFromStreamable(o, sType));
304      }
305      var swapped = applySwap(o, sType);
306      var aType = getClassMetaForObject(swapped);
307      if (aType.isBean())
308         return List.of(toBeanMap(swapped));
309      return List.of(toBeanMap(createWrapperBean(swapped)));
310   }

312   /** Simple bean for wrapping non-bean values (Map is not convertible to BeanMap). */
313   @SuppressWarnings({
314      "java:S1104" // Public field required for Parquet schema
315   })
316   public static class ValueHolder {
317      /** The wrapped value. */
318      public Object value;
319   }
320
321   private static Object createWrapperBean(Object value) throws SerializeException {
322      var h = new ValueHolder();
323      h.value = value;
324      return h;
325   }
326
327   private Object applySwap(Object value, ClassMeta<?> type) throws SerializeException {
328      var swap = type.getSwap(this);
329      if (nn(swap))
330         return swap(swap, value);
331      return value;
332   }
333
334   /**
335    * Applies any class-level swap registered via {@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.swap.DefaultSwaps}
336    * (or context-registered swaps) to a leaf value just before it is written to a Parquet column.
337    *
338    * <p>
339    * Necessary because bean-property values pass through {@link BeanMap#get(Object)}, which only
340    * applies the per-property {@code readTransform} installed by
341    * {@code MarshalledPropertyPostProcessor}.  At {@code NOT_SET} / unconfigured formats no
342    * per-property swap is installed for {@code Class<?>} (and other types whose default swap lives
343    * in {@code DefaultSwaps}); without this hook the raw value would fall through to
344    * {@link String#valueOf(Object)} and produce wires like {@code "class java.lang.String"}.
345    *
346    * <p>
347    * Mirrors the {@code aType.getSwap(session)} layer applied by every other serializer
348    * ({@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.json.JsonSerializerSession},
349    * {@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.msgpack.MsgPackSerializerSession}, etc.) in their {@code
350    * writeAnything} dispatcher.  No-op for values whose runtime type has no registered swap.
351    */
352   private Object applyDefaultSwap(Object value) throws SerializeException {
353      var cm = getClassMetaForObject(value);
354      var swap = cm.getSwap(this);
355      if (nn(swap))
356         return swap(swap, value);
357      return value;
358   }
359
360   private ColumnChunkMeta writeColumnChunk(OutputStream out, List<?> rows, ParquetSchemaElement col, long chunkStart) throws IOException, SerializeException {
361      var path = rowRelativePath(col.path);
362      if (path.contains(".list.element"))
363         return writeListColumnChunk(out, rows, col, path, chunkStart);
364      if (isMapKeyValueColumnPath(path))
365         return writeMapColumnChunk(out, rows, col, path, chunkStart);
366      // Definition-level handling for non-list/non-map columns.
367      // A leaf nested under N OPTIONAL groups needs a max def level of N (GAP-14) so the reader can tell
368      // a null intermediate group apart from a present group with a null leaf.  Single-segment columns
369      // (maxDef==1) use the original 1-bit scheme unchanged.
370      int maxDef = path.split("\\.").length;
371      int numRows = rows.size();
372
373      // Multi-page write (GAP-1 round-trip): split the column's rows into page batches of rowsPerPage.
374      // Defaults keep a single page (huge cap); a small pageSize produces several data pages in one chunk,
375      // which the page-loop reader concatenates.
376      int rowsPerPage = rowsPerPage();
377      var pathParts = List.of(col.path.split("\\."));
378      long totalUncompressed = 0;
379      long totalStored = 0;
380      int firstHeaderSize = 0;
381      boolean firstPage = true;
382      for (int start = 0; start < numRows; start += rowsPerPage) {
383         var pageRows = rows.subList(start, Math.min(start + rowsPerPage, numRows));
384         byte[] pageData = encodeColumnPage(pageRows, col, path, maxDef);
385         int uncompressedSize = pageData.length;
386         byte[] compressedData = ctx.compressionCodec.compress(pageData);
387         int compressedSize = compressedData.length;
388         var pageHeader = ParquetColumnWriter.createPageHeader(pageRows.size(), uncompressedSize, compressedSize);
389         out.write(pageHeader);
390         out.write(compressedData);
391         totalUncompressed += uncompressedSize;
392         totalStored += compressedSize + (long) pageHeader.length;
393         if (firstPage) {
394            firstHeaderSize = pageHeader.length;
395            firstPage = false;
396         }
397      }
398      return new ColumnChunkMeta(col.path, pathParts, col.type, numRows, totalUncompressed, totalStored, chunkStart, firstHeaderSize);
399   }
400
401   private int rowsPerPage() {
402      long n = Math.max(1, ctx.pageSize / BYTES_PER_ROW_ESTIMATE);
403      return (int) Math.min(n, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
404   }
405
406   /** Encodes one data page (def levels + PLAIN values) for a batch of rows of a non-list/non-map column. */
407   private byte[] encodeColumnPage(List<?> rows, ParquetSchemaElement col, String path, int maxDef) throws IOException, SerializeException {
408      var writer = new ParquetColumnWriter(col);
409      byte[] defLevelBytes;
410      if (maxDef >= 2) {
411         var defLevels = new RleBitPackingEncoder(defRepBitWidth(maxDef));
412         for (var row : rows) {
413            var dv = computeDefValue(row, path, maxDef);
414            defLevels.writeInt(dv.def());
415            if (dv.def() == maxDef)
416               writeValue(writer, col, dv.value());
417         }
418         defLevelBytes = defLevels.toByteArrayWithLength();
419      } else {
420         var values = extractColumnValues(rows, path);
421         // Root key_value format uses root.key/root.value - convert keys to stored strings (ISO8601, etc.)
422         boolean isRootKeyColumn = "root.key".equals(col.path);
423         if (isRootKeyColumn) {
424            var converted = new ArrayList<>(values.size());
425            for (var val : values) {
426               converted.add(val == null ? null : mapKeyToStoredString(unwrapOptional(val)));
427            }
428            values = converted;
429         }
430         var defLevels = new RleBitPackingEncoder(1);
431         for (var i = 0; i < values.size(); i++) {
432            var v = unwrapOptional(values.get(i));
433            defLevels.writeInt(v == null ? 0 : 1);
434            if (v != null)
435               writeValue(writer, col, v);
436         }
437         defLevelBytes = defLevels.toByteArrayWithLength();
438      }
439      byte[] valueBytes = writer.finalizePage();
440      byte[] pageData = new byte[defLevelBytes.length + valueBytes.length];
441      System.arraycopy(defLevelBytes, 0, pageData, 0, defLevelBytes.length);
442      System.arraycopy(valueBytes, 0, pageData, defLevelBytes.length, valueBytes.length);
443      return pageData;
444   }
445
446   private record DefValue(int def, Object value) {}
447
448   /**
449    * Walks {@code path} from {@code row}, returning the definition level (count of leading present OPTIONAL
450    * nodes) and the leaf value.  Used by multi-level OPTIONAL columns (GAP-14): {@code def == maxDef} means
451    * the leaf is present; {@code def == maxDef-1} means the deepest group is present but the leaf is null;
452    * {@code def < maxDef-1} means an intermediate group is null at level {@code def}.
453    */
454   private DefValue computeDefValue(Object row, String path, int maxDef) throws SerializeException {
455      var parts = path.split("\\.");
456      var seen = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<Object,Boolean>());
457      seen.add(row);
458      seen.add(((BeanMap<?>) row).getBean());
459      Object current = row;
460      int def = 0;
461      for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
462         var part = parts[i];
463         if (current instanceof Optional<?> current2)
464            current = current2.orElse(null);
465         else if (current instanceof BeanMap<?> current2)
466            current = current2.get(part);
467         else
468            current = toBeanMap(current).get(part);
469         if (current != null && seen.contains(current))
470            current = handleCycle(path);
471         if (current == null)
472            return new DefValue(def, null);
473         seen.add(current);
474         def = i + 1;
475      }
476      return new DefValue(maxDef, unwrapOptional(current));
477   }
478
479   /** Returns true if path is a map key_value leaf (e.g. f9.key_value.key or f9.key_value.value). */
480   private static boolean isMapKeyValueColumnPath(String path) {
481      return path.endsWith(".key_value.key") || path.endsWith(".key_value.value");
482   }
483
484   /** For map key_value path like "f9.key_value.key", returns the map property name ("f9"). */
485   private static String mapPropertyPath(String mapKeyValuePath) {
486      return mapKeyValuePath.substring(0, mapKeyValuePath.indexOf(".key_value."));
487   }
488
489   /** Path relative to the row (bean) for extraction. All schema leaf paths start with "root.". */
490   private static String rowRelativePath(String fullPath) {
491      return fullPath.substring("root.".length());
492   }
493
494   private static int listDepth(String path) {
495      int depth = 0;
496      for (int idx = 0; (idx = path.indexOf(".list.element", idx)) >= 0; idx += 13)
497         depth++;
498      return depth;
499   }
500
501   private static int maxDefLevelForListPath(String path) {
502      return 3 * listDepth(path);
503   }
504
505   private static int defRepBitWidth(int maxLevel) {
506      return 32 - Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros(maxLevel);
507   }
508
509   private ColumnChunkMeta writeListColumnChunk(OutputStream out, List<?> rows, ParquetSchemaElement col, String path, long chunkStart) throws IOException, SerializeException {
510      var flattened = extractFlattenedListValues(rows, path);
511      int maxDef = maxDefLevelForListPath(path);
512      int maxRep = listDepth(path);
513      int defBitWidth = defRepBitWidth(maxDef);
514      int repBitWidth = defRepBitWidth(maxRep);
515      var defLevels = new RleBitPackingEncoder(defBitWidth);
516      var repLevels = new RleBitPackingEncoder(repBitWidth);
517      var writer = new ParquetColumnWriter(col);
518      for (var e : flattened) {
519         repLevels.writeInt(e.repLevel);
520         defLevels.writeInt(e.defLevel);
521         var v = unwrapOptional(e.value);
522         if (e.defLevel >= maxDef)
523            writeValue(writer, col, v);
524      }
525      byte[] valueBytes = writer.finalizePage();
526      byte[] defLevelBytes = defLevels.toByteArrayWithLength();
527      byte[] repLevelBytes = repLevels.toByteArrayWithLength();
528      byte[] pageData = new byte[repLevelBytes.length + defLevelBytes.length + valueBytes.length];
529      int off = 0;
530      System.arraycopy(repLevelBytes, 0, pageData, off, repLevelBytes.length);
531      off += repLevelBytes.length;
532      System.arraycopy(defLevelBytes, 0, pageData, off, defLevelBytes.length);
533      off += defLevelBytes.length;
534      System.arraycopy(valueBytes, 0, pageData, off, valueBytes.length);
535      int uncompressedSize = pageData.length;
536      byte[] compressedData = ctx.compressionCodec.compress(pageData);
537      int compressedSize = compressedData.length;
538      var pageHeader = ParquetColumnWriter.createPageHeader(flattened.size(), uncompressedSize, compressedSize);
539      out.write(pageHeader);
540      int headerSize = pageHeader.length;
541      out.write(compressedData);
542      var pathParts = List.of(col.path.split("\\."));
543      return new ColumnChunkMeta(col.path, pathParts, col.type, flattened.size(), uncompressedSize, compressedSize + (long) headerSize, chunkStart, headerSize);
544   }
545
546   private ColumnChunkMeta writeMapColumnChunk(OutputStream out, List<?> rows, ParquetSchemaElement col, String path, long chunkStart) throws IOException, SerializeException {
547      boolean isKeyColumn = path.endsWith(".key_value.key");
548      var flattened = extractFlattenedMapValues(rows, path, isKeyColumn);
549      int defBitWidth = defRepBitWidth(MAP_MAX_DEF);
550      int repBitWidth = defRepBitWidth(MAP_MAX_REP);
551      var defLevels = new RleBitPackingEncoder(defBitWidth);
552      var repLevels = new RleBitPackingEncoder(repBitWidth);
553      var writer = new ParquetColumnWriter(col);
554      for (var e : flattened) {
555         repLevels.writeInt(e.repLevel);
556         defLevels.writeInt(e.defLevel);
557         var v = unwrapOptional(e.value);
558         if (e.defLevel >= MAP_MAX_DEF)
559            writeValue(writer, col, v);
560      }
561      byte[] valueBytes = writer.finalizePage();
562      byte[] defLevelBytes = defLevels.toByteArrayWithLength();
563      byte[] repLevelBytes = repLevels.toByteArrayWithLength();
564      byte[] pageData = new byte[repLevelBytes.length + defLevelBytes.length + valueBytes.length];
565      int off = 0;
566      System.arraycopy(repLevelBytes, 0, pageData, off, repLevelBytes.length);
567      off += repLevelBytes.length;
568      System.arraycopy(defLevelBytes, 0, pageData, off, defLevelBytes.length);
569      off += defLevelBytes.length;
570      System.arraycopy(valueBytes, 0, pageData, off, valueBytes.length);
571      int uncompressedSize = pageData.length;
572      byte[] compressedData = ctx.compressionCodec.compress(pageData);
573      int compressedSize = compressedData.length;
574      var pageHeader = ParquetColumnWriter.createPageHeader(flattened.size(), uncompressedSize, compressedSize);
575      out.write(pageHeader);
576      int headerSize = pageHeader.length;
577      out.write(compressedData);
578      var pathParts = List.of(col.path.split("\\."));
579      return new ColumnChunkMeta(col.path, pathParts, col.type, flattened.size(), uncompressedSize, compressedSize + (long) headerSize, chunkStart, headerSize);
580   }

584   /** Converts a map key to the string stored in Parquet (UTF8). Handles null, Date, Enum like other formats. */
585   private Object mapKeyToStoredString(Object key) throws SerializeException {
586      if (key == null)
587         return ctx.nullKeyString;
588      if (key instanceof Date key2) {
589         var cm = getClassMetaForObject(key2);
590         return writeDate(key2, cm);
591      }
592      if (key instanceof Calendar) {
593         var cm = getClassMetaForObject(key);
594         return writeCalendar(key, cm);
595      }
596      if (key instanceof TemporalAccessor key2) {
597         var cm = getClassMetaForObject(key2);
598         return writeTemporal(key2, cm);
599      }
600      if (key instanceof Enum<?> key2)
601         return ctx.getMarshallingContext().getEnumFormat().format(key2);
602      return trim(String.valueOf(generalize(key, getClassMetaForObject(key))));
603   }

605   private List<FlattenedEntry> extractFlattenedListValues(List<?> rows, String path) throws SerializeException {
606      var result = new ArrayList<FlattenedEntry>();
607      int maxDef = maxDefLevelForListPath(path);
608      int depth = listDepth(path);
609      for (var row : rows) {
610         var seen = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<Object,Boolean>());
611         flattenListValues(row, path, 0, true, 0, depth, maxDef, result, seen);
612      }

616   private static final int MAP_MAX_DEF = 2;
617   private static final int MAP_MAX_REP = 1;
618
619   private List<FlattenedEntry> extractFlattenedMapValues(List<?> rows, String path, boolean isKeyColumn) throws SerializeException {
620      var result = new ArrayList<FlattenedEntry>();
621      var mapProp = mapPropertyPath(path);
622      for (var row : rows) {
623         var map = getMapAtPath(row, mapProp);
624         if (!map.isEmpty()) {
625            int idx = 0;
626            for (var e : map.entrySet()) {
627               int rep = idx == 0 ? 0 : MAP_MAX_REP;
628               Object val = isKeyColumn ? e.getKey() : e.getValue();
629               val = unwrapOptional(val);
630               if (isKeyColumn)
631                  val = mapKeyToStoredString(val);
632               int def = val != null ? MAP_MAX_DEF : 1;
633               result.add(new FlattenedEntry(val, def, rep));
634               idx++;
635            }
636         }
637      }
638      return result;
639   }

641   private Map<?,?> getMapAtPath(Object row, String mapProp) throws SerializeException {
642      var obj = getValueByPath(row, mapProp);
643      if (obj == null)
644         return Collections.emptyMap();
645      return (Map<?,?>) obj;

648   @SuppressWarnings({
649      "java:S107" // Recursive list flattening requires path/index/def/rep context; refactor would obscure
650   })
651   private void flattenListValues(Object obj, String path, int partIndex, boolean firstInRow, int currentRep, int listDepth, int maxDef, List<FlattenedEntry> out, Set<Object> seen) throws SerializeException {
652      if (obj != null && seen.contains(obj)) {
653         if (ctx.cycleHandling == ParquetCycleHandling.THROW)
654            throw new SerializeException("Cyclic reference at path '%s'. Set cycleHandling(NULL) to serialize as null.", path);
655         out.add(new FlattenedEntry(null, Math.max(0, maxDef - 1), currentRep));
656         return;
657      }
658      if (obj != null)
659         seen.add(obj);
660      try {
661         flattenListValuesImpl(obj, path, partIndex, firstInRow, currentRep, listDepth, maxDef, out, seen);
662      } finally {
663         if (obj != null)
664            seen.remove(obj);
665      }
666   }
667
668   @SuppressWarnings({
669      "java:S107" // Recursive list flattening requires path/index/def/rep context; refactor would obscure
670   })
671   private void flattenListValuesImpl(Object obj, String path, int partIndex, boolean firstInRow, int currentRep, int listDepth, int maxDef, List<FlattenedEntry> out, Set<Object> seen) throws SerializeException {
672      var parts = path.split("\\.");
673      if (partIndex >= parts.length) {
674         var val = unwrapOptional(obj);
675         out.add(new FlattenedEntry(val, val != null ? maxDef : Math.max(0, maxDef - 1), currentRep));
676         return;
677      }
678      if (partIndex + 1 < parts.length && "list".equals(parts[partIndex]) && "element".equals(parts[partIndex + 1])) {
679         Collection<?> list = null;
680         if (obj != null) {
681         if (obj instanceof Collection<?> obj2)
682            list = obj2;
683         else if (obj instanceof Object[] obj2) {
684            list = Arrays.asList(obj2);
685         } else if (obj.getClass().isArray()) {
686            // Primitive arrays (boolean[], int[], char[], etc.) — box each element
687            int len = Array.getLength(obj);
688            var al = new ArrayList<>(len);
689            for (int ai = 0; ai < len; ai++)
690               al.add(Array.get(obj, ai));
691            list = al;
692         } else
693            list = Collections.singletonList(obj);
694         }
695      // Count how many "list" segments have appeared up to and including partIndex.
696      // This gives the true nesting depth regardless of non-list path segments (e.g. "value" for Optional).
697      int listDepthHere = 0;
698      for (int di = 0; di <= partIndex; di++)
699         if ("list".equals(parts[di]))
700            listDepthHere++;
701      // def levels for null/empty: 2*(depth-1) and 2*(depth-1)+1, so depth=1 → 0,1; depth=2 → 2,3.
702      int nullDef  = 2 * (listDepthHere - 1);
703      int emptyDef = 2 * (listDepthHere - 1) + 1;
704      if (list == null) {
705         out.add(new FlattenedEntry(null, nullDef, firstInRow ? 0 : currentRep));
706         return;
707      }
708      if (list.isEmpty()) {
709         out.add(new FlattenedEntry(null, emptyDef, firstInRow ? 0 : currentRep));
710         return;
711      }
712      int level = partIndex / 2 + 1;
713      // Use currentRep for the first-element rep level so nested lists carry the correct rep from their parent.
714      int repLevel = firstInRow ? 0 : currentRep;
715         int idx = 0;
716         for (var item : list) {
717            int r = idx == 0 ? repLevel : level;
718            var val = unwrapOptional(item);
719            int def = val == null ? Math.max(0, maxDef - 1) : maxDef;
720            if (partIndex + 2 >= parts.length) {
721               out.add(new FlattenedEntry(val, def, r));
722            } else {
723               flattenListValues(item, path, partIndex + 2, firstInRow, r, listDepth, maxDef, out, seen);
724            }
725            firstInRow = false;
726            idx++;
727         }
728         return;
729      }
730      Object next = obj;
731      if (next != null) {
732         if (next instanceof Optional<?> next2)
733            next = next2.orElse(null);
734         else if (next instanceof BeanMap<?> next2)
735            next = next2.get(parts[partIndex]);
736         else if (next instanceof Map<?,?> next2)
737            next = next2.get(parts[partIndex]);
738         else
739            next = toBeanMap(next).get(parts[partIndex]);
740      }
741      flattenListValues(next, path, partIndex + 1, firstInRow, currentRep, listDepth, maxDef, out, seen);
742   }

744   private List<Object> extractColumnValues(List<?> rows, String path) throws SerializeException {
745      var result = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
746      for (var row : rows)
747         result.add(getValueByPath(row, path));
748      return result;
749   }

751   private Object getValueByPath(Object row, String path) throws SerializeException {
752      var parts = path.split("\\.");
753      var seen = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<Object,Boolean>());
754      seen.add(row);
755      if (row instanceof BeanMap<?> row2)
756         seen.add(row2.getBean());
757      Object current = row;
758      for (var part : parts) {
759         if (current == null)
760            return null;
761         if (current instanceof BeanMap<?> current2)
762            current = current2.get(part);
763         else if (current instanceof Map<?,?> current2)
764            current = current2.get(part);
765         else
766            current = toBeanMap(current).get(part);
767         if (current != null && seen.contains(current))
768            return handleCycle(path);
769         if (current != null)
770            seen.add(current);
771      }
772      return current;
773   }
774
775   private Object handleCycle(String path) throws SerializeException {
776      if (ctx.cycleHandling == ParquetCycleHandling.THROW)
777         throw new SerializeException("Cyclic reference at path '%s'. Set cycleHandling(NULL) to serialize as null.", path);
778      return null;
779   }

781   /** Unwraps Optional (including nested Optional<Optional<T>>) to inner value or null. */
782   private static Object unwrapOptional(Object v) {
783      while (v instanceof Optional<?> v2) {
784         v = v2.orElse(null);
785      }
786      return v;
787   }

789   private void writeValue(ParquetColumnWriter w, ParquetSchemaElement col, Object v) throws IOException, SerializeException {
790      // Unwrap handled by callers (writeColumnChunk, writeListColumnChunk) for correct def levels
791      v = unwrapOptional(v);
792      v = applyDefaultSwap(v);
793      switch (col.type) {
794         case TYPE_BOOLEAN:
795            w.writeBoolean(v instanceof Boolean v2 ? v2 : Boolean.parseBoolean(String.valueOf(v)));
796            break;
797         case TYPE_INT32:
798            // Native DATE (GAP-10): days since epoch.
799            if (col.convertedType == CONVERTED_DATE)
800               w.writeInt32((int) toEpochDay(v));
801            else
802               w.writeInt32(toInt32(v));
803            break;
804         case TYPE_INT64:
805            // Native logical INT64 encodings (GAP-9/10): DECIMAL unscaled, TIME/TIMESTAMP in micros.
806            if (col.convertedType == CONVERTED_DECIMAL)
807               w.writeInt64(toDecimalUnscaled(v));
808            else if (col.convertedType == CONVERTED_TIME_MICROS)
809               w.writeInt64(toTimeMicros(v));
810            else if (col.convertedType == CONVERTED_TIMESTAMP_MICROS)
811               w.writeInt64(toTimestampMicros(v));
812            else
813               w.writeInt64(toInt64(v));
814            break;
815         case TYPE_FLOAT:
816            w.writeFloat(v instanceof Number v2 ? v2.floatValue() : Float.parseFloat(String.valueOf(v)));
817            break;
818         case TYPE_DOUBLE:
819            w.writeDouble(v instanceof Number v2 ? v2.doubleValue() : Double.parseDouble(String.valueOf(v)));
820            break;
821         case TYPE_BYTE_ARRAY:
822            w.writeByteArray(toByteArray(v));
823            break;
824         case TYPE_FIXED_LEN_BYTE_ARRAY:
825            w.writeFixedLenByteArray(toFixedLenByteArray(v));
826            break;
827         default:
828            throw new SerializeException("Unsupported Parquet physical type: %s", col.type);
829      }
830   }

832   private static int toInt32(Object v) {
833      if (v instanceof Number v2)
834         return v2.intValue();
835      return Integer.parseInt(String.valueOf(v));
836   }

838   private static long toInt64(Object v) throws SerializeException {
839      if (v instanceof Date v2)
840         return v2.getTime();
841      if (v instanceof Calendar v2)
842         return v2.getTimeInMillis();
843      if (v instanceof Instant v2)
844         return v2.toEpochMilli();
845      if (v instanceof LocalDate v2)
846         return v2.atStartOfDay(ZoneOffset.UTC).toInstant().toEpochMilli();
847      if (v instanceof LocalDateTime v2)
848         return v2.atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC).toInstant().toEpochMilli();
849      if (v instanceof LocalTime v2)
850         return Duration.ofNanos(v2.toNanoOfDay()).toMillis();
851      if (v instanceof ZonedDateTime v2)
852         return v2.toInstant().toEpochMilli();
853      if (v instanceof OffsetDateTime v2)
854         return v2.toInstant().toEpochMilli();
855      if (v instanceof OffsetTime v2)
856         return Duration.ofNanos(v2.toLocalTime().toNanoOfDay()).toMillis();
857      if (v instanceof Year v2)
858         return v2.atDay(1).atStartOfDay(ZoneOffset.UTC).toInstant().toEpochMilli();
859      if (v instanceof YearMonth v2)
860         return v2.atDay(1).atStartOfDay(ZoneOffset.UTC).toInstant().toEpochMilli();
861      if (v instanceof TemporalAccessor v2) {
862         try {
863            return Instant.from(v2).toEpochMilli();
864         } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") Exception e) {
865            return Long.parseLong(String.valueOf(v));
866         }
867      }
868      if (v instanceof Number v2)
869         return v2.longValue();
870      return Long.parseLong(String.valueOf(v));
871   }

873   /** Native DATE (GAP-10): epoch-day from a date-like temporal. */
874   private static long toEpochDay(Object v) throws SerializeException {
875      if (v instanceof LocalDate v2)
876         return v2.toEpochDay();
877      if (v instanceof LocalDateTime v2)
878         return v2.toLocalDate().toEpochDay();
879      if (v instanceof Instant v2)
880         return v2.atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDate().toEpochDay();
881      if (v instanceof ZonedDateTime v2)
882         return v2.toLocalDate().toEpochDay();
883      if (v instanceof OffsetDateTime v2)
884         return v2.toLocalDate().toEpochDay();
885      if (v instanceof Number v2)
886         return v2.longValue();
887      return LocalDate.parse(String.valueOf(v)).toEpochDay();
888   }
889
890   /** Native TIME_MICROS (GAP-10): micros since midnight. */
891   private static long toTimeMicros(Object v) {
892      if (v instanceof LocalTime v2)
893         return v2.toNanoOfDay() / 1_000L;
894      if (v instanceof OffsetTime v2)
895         return v2.toLocalTime().toNanoOfDay() / 1_000L;
896      if (v instanceof Number v2)
897         return v2.longValue();
898      return LocalTime.parse(String.valueOf(v)).toNanoOfDay() / 1_000L;
899   }

901   /** Native TIMESTAMP_MICROS (GAP-10): micros since epoch, sub-millisecond precise. */
902   private static long toTimestampMicros(Object v) throws SerializeException {
903      Instant i = toInstant(v);
904      return Math.multiplyExact(i.getEpochSecond(), 1_000_000L) + i.getNano() / 1_000L;
905   }

907   private static Instant toInstant(Object v) throws SerializeException {
908      if (v instanceof Instant v2)
909         return v2;
910      if (v instanceof Date v2)
911         return v2.toInstant();
912      if (v instanceof Calendar v2)
913         return v2.toInstant();
914      if (v instanceof LocalDateTime v2)
915         return v2.toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC);
916      if (v instanceof LocalDate v2)
917         return v2.atStartOfDay(ZoneOffset.UTC).toInstant();
918      if (v instanceof ZonedDateTime v2)
919         return v2.toInstant();
920      if (v instanceof OffsetDateTime v2)
921         return v2.toInstant();
922      if (v instanceof TemporalAccessor v2) {
923         try {
924            return Instant.from(v2);
925         } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") Exception e) {
926            // fall through to string parse
927         }
928      }
929      try {
930         return Instant.parse(String.valueOf(v));
931      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") Exception e) {
932         throw new SerializeException("Cannot convert value of type %s to a TIMESTAMP", v.getClass().getName());
933      }
934   }

936   /** Native DECIMAL (GAP-9): unscaled INT64 at the fixed schema scale; over-precise values are rounded. */
937   private static long toDecimalUnscaled(Object v) throws SerializeException {
938      java.math.BigDecimal bd;
939      if (v instanceof java.math.BigDecimal v2)
940         bd = v2;
941      else if (v instanceof Number v2)
942         bd = new java.math.BigDecimal(v2.toString());
943      else
944         bd = new java.math.BigDecimal(String.valueOf(v));
945      // Scale to the fixed schema scale (round half-up), then take the unscaled long.
946      return bd.setScale(ParquetSchemaBuilder.DECIMAL_SCALE, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP).unscaledValue().longValueExact();
947   }

949   private byte[] toByteArray(Object v) throws SerializeException {
950      if (v instanceof byte[] v2)
951         return v2;
952      if (v instanceof String v2)
953         return trim(v2).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
954      if (v instanceof Enum<?> v2)
955         return ctx.getMarshallingContext().getEnumFormat().format(v2).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
956      if (v instanceof Duration v2)
957         return v2.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
958      // BigDecimal and all other types stored as UTF-8 string.
959      return String.valueOf(v).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
960   }

962   private static byte[] toFixedLenByteArray(Object v) {
963      if (v instanceof UUID v2) {
964         byte[] b = new byte[16];
965         var msb = v2.getMostSignificantBits();
966         var lsb = v2.getLeastSignificantBits();
967         for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
968            b[i] = (byte)((msb >> (56 - i * 8)) & 0xFF);
969         for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
970            b[8 + i] = (byte)((lsb >> (56 - i * 8)) & 0xFF);
971         return b;
972      }
973      return new byte[16];
974   }

976   private byte[] writeFileMetaData(List<ParquetSchemaElement> schema, long numRows, List<RowGroupMeta> rowGroups) throws IOException {
977      return ThriftCompactEncoder.encodeToBytes(enc -> {
978         enc.writeStructBegin();
979         enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.I32, 1);
980         enc.writeI32(1);
981         enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.LIST, 2);
982         enc.writeListBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.STRUCT, schema.size());
983         for (var e : schema)
984            e.writeTo(enc, ctx.emitLogicalTypes);
985         enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.I64, 3);
986         enc.writeI64(numRows);
987         enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.LIST, 4);
988         enc.writeListBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.STRUCT, rowGroups.size());
989         for (var rg : rowGroups) {
990            enc.writeStructBegin();
991            enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.LIST, 1);
992            enc.writeListBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.STRUCT, rg.columns.size());
993            for (var cc : rg.columns) {
994               enc.writeStructBegin();
995               enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.I64, 2);
996               enc.writeI64(cc.fileOffset);
997               enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.STRUCT, 3);
998               writeColumnMetaData(enc, cc);
999               enc.writeStructEnd();
1000            }
1001            enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.I64, 2);
1002            enc.writeI64(rg.totalByteSize);
1003            enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.I64, 3);
1004            enc.writeI64(rg.numRows);
1005            enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.I64, 5);
1006            enc.writeI64(rg.fileOffset);
1007            enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.I64, 6);
1008            enc.writeI64(rg.totalCompressedSize);
1009            enc.writeStructEnd();
1010         }
1011         enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.BINARY, 6);
1012         enc.writeString("Apache Juneau");
1013         enc.writeStructEnd();
1014      });
1015   }

1017   private void writeColumnMetaData(ThriftCompactEncoder enc, ColumnChunkMeta cc) throws IOException {
1018      enc.writeStructBegin();

1020      enc.writeI32(cc.parquetType);

1024      enc.writeI32(3);

1029      enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.I32, 4);
1030      enc.writeI32(ctx.compressionCodec.thriftValue);
1031      enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.I64, 5);
1032      enc.writeI64(cc.numValues);
1033      enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.I64, 6);
1034      enc.writeI64(cc.totalUncompressedSize);
1035      enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.I64, 7);
1036      enc.writeI64(cc.totalCompressedSize);
1037      enc.writeFieldBegin(ThriftCompactEncoder.I64, 9);
1038      enc.writeI64(cc.fileOffset);
